learning_objective: 🎯 Become a mathematical detective by setting up balanced equations to solve real-world mysteries and find the exact value of secret numbers!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: An equation is exactly like a weighing scale. The left side must always weigh the same as the right side. The golden rule is: Whatever math operation you do to one side, you MUST do to the other side to keep it balanced!
To find the value of our unknown letter (like 'x'), we need to get it completely alone on one side of the equal sign. We do this by doing the opposite math. If the equation adds 5, we subtract 5!
We can turn real-life word puzzles into math equations! If a mystery number doubled plus 3 equals 11, we simply write it as '2x + 3 = 11' and solve the case.

fun_activity.title: 🧩 The Digroz Coin Mystery
fun_activity.instructions: Hide some coins under a cup and put 3 coins outside the cup. Tell your parents there are 10 coins in total. Ask them to write a simple equation (x + 3 = 10) to find exactly how many coins are hiding!

quick_recap: ⭐ An equation uses an equal sign to show that two expressions have the exact same value.
⭐ You must perform the identical operation on both sides to maintain the mathematical balance.
⭐ Solving an equation means finding the exact number that makes the statement true.
